encoding: depth in metres = (v / 255) ** 2 * dmax; v = 0 is land or at/above MHW
note: Node (i, j) maps to bbox4326 by linear interpolation; j increases NORTH, the same convention as base/water.

source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
source.dataset: San Francisco Bay, California Coastal Digital Elevation Model (san_francisco_13_mhw_2010)
source.what: integrated bathymetric-topographic DEM at 1/3 arc-second, MHW vertical datum, WGS84 horizontal. Built by NOAA for the PMEL tsunami forecast system, which is why land and sea are one continuous surface.
source.reduced: every 5th node of the published grid, taken in the pipeline. The plate that reads this bakes at 52 m a texel, so 40.7 x 51.5 m is finer than the thing that samples it and the rest would be discarded.
